headline: Operations Analyst | Reporting and Dashboards | Process Improvement

bullets.text: Rebuilt the weekly carrier-performance report from four manual spreadsheets into one SQL-backed Looker dashboard, cutting prep time from about 6 hours to under 1 hour a week.
Mapped the damaged-shipment claims process with customer service and finance, reducing average claim resolution from 14 days to 9.
Own data quality checks for 2,000+ weekly shipments.
Flag shipment data anomalies to dispatch leads.
Run weekly performance reviews with 8 regional carriers using the new dashboard.
Trained 12 dispatchers on the new dashboard.
Wrote the internal how-to guide dispatchers use for the dashboard.
Handled 60+ customer tickets a day in Zendesk across order, billing, and delivery issues.
Kept CSAT above 94% while working that daily ticket volume.
Built a library of 40+ saved-reply macros that the team adopted as its standard.
Tagged and categorized ticket drivers every month.
The monthly top-three driver report fed product roadmap reviews.
Scheduled 15 student workers across three service desks each semester.
Tracked loans for 300+ laptops and hotspots during remote learning.

projects.title: Transit Delay Tracker
